problem: linkedin_personal depended on Buffer for both create and provider readback. Buffer HTTP 429 therefore blocked daily personal LinkedIn delivery. Direct LinkedIn author-feed listing also returned HTTP 403 because the connected app lacks the finder permission required for that endpoint.
root_cause: The personal LinkedIn transport was coupled to Buffer even though the authenticated LinkedIn connection has member write access.
Verification depended on provider list/read patterns instead of retaining the exact post identifier returned by the write.
A Buffer circuit-open state gated both linkedin_personal and linkedin_company.
prevention: Persist the LinkedIn post URN returned by CREATE_LINKED_IN_POST as the canonical delivery_ref.
Read back exactly that URN with LINKEDIN_GET_POST_CONTENT; never depend on author-feed finder permission for write verification.
Keep the existing single-writer claim and publication capability as the idempotency authority.
On uncertain direct LinkedIn readback, fail closed and never create a replacement through Buffer.
Buffer circuit state may defer linkedin_company while it remains Buffer-dependent, but must never gate linkedin_personal.

evidence.buffer_failure: HTTP 429 Retry-After observed on Buffer account/readback calls
evidence.native_readback_contract: LINKEDIN_CREATE_LINKED_IN_POST returns x_restli_id; LINKEDIN_GET_POST_CONTENT reads one exact post URN
evidence.regression_test: tests/brain-buffer-rate-limit-circuit-v1.test.mjs enforces direct personal LinkedIn transport and exact readback

scope_note: LinkedIn organization admin lookup still lacks r_organization_admin. This does not block the personal LinkedIn transport and must not be worked around by weakening fail-closed guarantees.

canary: Exact LinkedIn create response must yield a canonical post URN and LINKEDIN_GET_POST_CONTENT must verify the same URN, author, commentary and PUBLISHED lifecycle before status becomes published.
shadow: With Buffer circuit open or Buffer unavailable, linkedin_personal must remain eligible for linkedin_direct while linkedin_company may be deferred until organization-native scope is available.
